book.name: 1 Timocheyo
book.title: Baluwa jhukutumbula jha Pauli kwa Timocheyo

content: Akabhanda bhoha bhipalwa bhanyenyekeya akanahota bhabhe kupala bhando bhakoto kuliligha liina lya Chapanga andajhe mabholo ghito.

Akabhanda bhubhabhii na akanahota bhabhe bhibhannyeketii Kilichitu bhangapucha jhe akanahota kwa bhikihwananicha ngita Akakilichitu ajhabhe. Nambo bhipalwa kwatumikila maha hake, nhwalo bheniya ndi bhibhajhambulila kuhumii mu mahengo ghabhe, bhibhahobholeka na bhibhapalwa. Mabholo ghu uwange na kichumo cha chakaka Yene ndi chimipalwa kubhola na kutangacha malobhe gheniya.
Mundo jhojhoha jwaibhola mabholo ghange ghangabhehe tela na ghanga, na jwangajheketela malobhe gha chakaka gha Bhambo gwito Kilichitu Yecho na kutama ngita chapala Chapanga,
jwenio atwelii kulokaloka na amanyite jhe kilebhe chochoha. Mundo jwatamii mitaho na bhulo na maligho na kuwachii bhange ghanganandela,
na mitaho jhangajhomoka kubhoka kwa bhando bheniya, malango ghabhe ghapoghanike kabhele nabhangabhehe na uchakaka. Bheniya bhihwacha kuntumikii Chapanga ndi ndela jha kichumo cha mbijha.
Chakaka kuntumikii Chapanga kummeka mundo abhaha na ulohe, anda ajheketela kubhehe atochike na ilebhe yakwete.
Nhwalo tuhikite jhe na kilebhe chochoha pannema pano, hilu natughegha jhe kilebhe chochoha pitujhenda kunane kwa Chapanga.
Yene, anda tukwete yakulyegha na ngobho, tupalwa tutocheka kubhehe na yenio.
Nambo bhala bhibhapala kubhehe na kichumo ugwegha mu majhighinikilo na mu ntambo gwa tama jha ghanganandela na undindilima ghighapeleka kuhobha na mukomelekelo.
Nhwalo kupala hake mbijha ndi kihokola cha mahakaho ghoha. Bhando bhange bhiloke hake kubhehe na mbijha ade kukileka kutale kihobholelo na kuijhocha miojho jhabhe kwa lipyanda kwa ghala ghibhahenga.
Malaghilo kwa Timocheyo
Nambo mwe, mamundo bha Chapanga, muibhambale ilebhe yenio. Nnyendelela kubhehe mambone palonge jha Chapanga, mtembekeya Chapanga na mme na kihobholelo na mme na upalo na mma naluhimba na mma manuu.

Nkachane hake kukomana ngondo jha kihobholelo nkamule ughome gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta, ughome Chapanga gwankemii pala pinnyeketila mabhene kihobholelo chino palonge jha bhando twe bhubhakibha peniya.
Ninaghila palonge jha Chapanga jwaipe ughome ilebhe yoha, na palonge jha Kilichitu Yecho jwalongela uchakaka palonge jha Pontiyo Pilatu,
nkamule malaghilo ghanga na kughajhokanikiya na ntende kwa kuhobholeka ade lichiko lela lyapala kubhujha Bhambo gwito Kilichitu Yecho.
Kubhujha kwakwe Yecho nakuhengeka machiko ghighabhekwitwe na Chapanga, jwenio jwabhii na ung'alicho, jwabhii Kilongoche kanjika ndo, jwenio jwabhii Bhambo jwa Mabhambo.

Jwenie kajhika ndo itama machiko ghoha ghangapeta mu lumule lwangahoto kuheghelelwa na mundo. Abhii jhe mundo jwahotwii kummona hilu jwahoto kummona. Ndi jhuna ichima na uhotolo gwa machiko ghoha ghangapeta! Amina.

Mwalaghalikiye bhando bhubhabhii na kichumo munnema ghongo gwa ngohe, bhangalokajhe, peniya bhaleke kuhobholela ulohe gwangahoto kuyobholeka nambo bhanhobholela Chapanga jwatupeke ghoha kwa umbone tuhangane.
Mwalaghalikiye bhahenga ghambone, bhabha na itendwa twe yambone na bhabha bhaumbone na bhajheketela kwabhaghulii bhange ilebhe yabhe.
Kwa kuhenga gheniya nakwatangatila kubhehe na kihukilo kibhehe nchinge nganganga na peniya nabhahotola kukipatii ughome gwa chakaka.
Mwe ma Timocheyo, mughalolekeye ghala ghoha ghinkamwiwe. Mmambale malobhe ghangabhehe gha Chapanga na ghanganandela na mataungano gha undindilima ndi bhando kwa uwange bhighakema, “Kumanya.”
Nhwalo bhando bhange bhakilokita kumanya kwenio kupeta undindilima, na kuhenga yenio bhahobhii kihobholelo. Umbone gwa Chapanga utama na mangota!
